units: <cite ref="Taanit 9b:9">Taan. 9ᵇ</cite> <he>מלא צ׳ דתמרי</he> a basketful of dates; <cite ref="Pesachim 88a:1">Pes. 88ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Chullin 57a:2">Ḥull. 57ᵃ</cite> <he>צ׳ דאינקורי</he> a basket (coop) of birds, v. <cite ref="A01392"><he>אִינְקוֹרָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 25a:5">B. Mets. 25ᵃ</cite> <he>בצ׳ ופירי</he> when one found a basket by the side of fruits.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 25a:7">Ib.</cite> <he>דאית ליה אוגנין לצ׳</he> when the basket has rims by which to handle it; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Megillah 28b:12">Meg. 28ᵇ</cite> <he>צ׳ דמלי סיפרי</he> a basket full of books, a man full of learning, but without method.
<cite ref="Megillah 7a:18">Ib. 7ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="H01686"><he>חָרִיף</he></cite>.—Pl. <he>צַנַּיָּא</he>, v. <cite ref="R00386"><he>צִינָּא</he> I</cite>.
